name: You can't fake a heart rate
notes: One creative for November 9: the "every test says I'm fine" hook, a real POTS Test result as the proof, and the download.

creatives.name: You can't fake a heart rate
creatives.title: Every test says I'm fine. So why can't I stand up without my heart racing?
creatives.goal: Three slides. The question every undiagnosed person lives with, the measurement that answers it, and the download.
creatives.caption: Every test came back normal, so I measured it myself 🩵 A stand test takes 15 minutes and the numbers don't argue. Autonomic is free on iOS & Android (link in bio), your phone's camera is enough to start, and your data never leaves your phone. Not medical advice. #pots #dysautonomia #longcovid #mecfs #chronicillness #hrv

text: So why can't I stand up without my heart racing?

img.shows: You sitting on the edge of the bed or a chair, hand on the wall, about to stand. Tired, not staged. No face needed.
img.frame: Subject in the lower two thirds; the hook sits across the top.

img.shows: A POTS Test result: sustained HR rise +38 bpm (Compromised), the heart rate trace jumping at the stand, baseline 76, peak 122.
img.frame: Raw full-height screenshot from the top; the +38 and the trace level with the copy.

text: *You can't fake a heart rate, prove them wrong.*

img.shows: You standing with your phone, mid stand test, or a phone on the arm of a chair with the capture running.
img.frame: Subject in the top half; the copy sits under the lockup over the darkened lower half.

music.notes: Starts restrained under the question, opens up when the result lands. Sincere, never dramatic.
